rule CobaltStrike_Beacon_Pattern {
    meta:
        description = "Detects memory patterns associated with Cobalt Strike beacons"
        author = "SOC_Team"
        reference = "MITRE ATT&CK T1071.001"
        tlp = "amber"
    strings:
        $a = { 2e 72 63 64 2e 65 78 65 } // ".rcd.exe"
        $b = "Mozilla/4.0 (compatible; MSIE 6.0; Windows NT 5.1;" 
        $c = { 67 65 74 20 2f 2a 2e 70 68 70 3f 2a 20 48 54 54 50 } // "get /*.php?* HTTP"
    condition:
        all of them
}

rule CobaltStrike_Beacon_Dropped_a1b2c3d4 {
    meta:
        description = "Detects CobaltStrike beacon dropped on compromised host (hash match)"
        author = "SOC_Team"
        hash = "a1b2c3d4e5f67890a1b2c3d4e5f67890a1b2c3d4e5f67890a1b2c3d4e5f67890"
        cve = "N/A"
    strings:
        $s1 = "GetSystemDirectory" wide
        $s2 = "kernel32.dll" wide
        $s3 = "WinHttpOpen" wide
        $x64_stub = { 48 89 5C 24 ? 48 89 74 24 ? 57 48 83 EC 20 8B F9 } // Common x64 reflective loader stub
    condition:
        uint16(0) == 0x5A4D and filesize < 100KB and all of ($s*) and $x64_stub
}

arguments.summary: Critical incident involving a compromised host (WS-FIN-042, 10.0.5.42) exhibiting Cobalt Strike beaconing and lateral movement, coinciding with imminent failure of SIEM hot storage (10.0.9.25). Forensic data preservation was prioritized due to RAID-6 array degradation. The compromised host in Finance showed evidence of phishing-based initial access (T1566.001), living-off-the-land execution via rundll32 (T1218.011), C2 beaconing (T1071.001), and attempted Kerberos exploitation (T1558.001) and SMB lateral movement (T1021.002). The storage node (WS-IT-101) itself showed only benign activity and prior low-severity scanning, deemed non-malicious. No direct link between the malware and storage failure was found; however, the convergence created a critical risk to forensic integrity.
